notes.title: 🌊 A New Nightmare Awaits — Sea of Dreams Survivors Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Dreamers,[/p][p]We have exciting news from the world of [i]Sea of Dreams[/i]![/p][p]The horrors aboard the [i]Sea of Dreams[/i] have spilled into a whole new kind of experience… and it's available to play [b]right now[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Introducing our brand-new standalone spin-off:
🎮 [b][i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3484590/view/537733876590575713"]Sea of Dreams Survivors[/url][/i][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3484590/view/537733876590575713"] is out now on Steam![/url][/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3484590/view/537733876590575713"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]What Is [i]Sea of Dreams Survivors[/i]?[/p][p][i]Sea of Dreams Survivors[/i] is a fast-paced action [b]rogue-lite survival game[/b], set in the same dark and mysterious universe as the original [i]Sea of Dreams[/i]. This time, instead of exploring the haunted ship room by room, you’re dropped into [i]The Other World[/i]—a twisted dimension where you must survive [b]relentless waves of enemies[/b], grow stronger, and escape with your life.[/p][p]It features:[/p][list][*][p]17 weapons, 9 characters, 15 perks, and 10 levels[/p][/*][*][p]31 achievements to unlock[/p][/*][*][p]Custom Game Mode once the campaign is completed[/p][/*][*][p]Rogue-lite progression, resettable upgrades, and multiple difficulty levels[/p][/*][*][p]And yes, it all takes place aboard the [i]Sea of Dreams[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]We can't wait to hear what you think. And thank you again for supporting [i]Sea of Dreams[/i]—none of this would be possible without you.[/p][p]See you in the dark,
— [i]The Dezeiraud Games Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Announcing Sea of Dreams Survivors – A New Nightmare Awaits
notes.notes:
Ahoy, dreamers!

We’re thrilled to announce Sea of Dreams Survivors, a brand-new spin-off set in the eerie and mysterious universe of Sea of Dreams! While it shares the same dark world, this game brings an entirely different experience—one of relentless action and survival against overwhelming odds.

[previewyoutube=WjMtfZbHpPk;full][/previewyoutube]

In this action-packed rogue-lite, you step into the shoes of a survivor trapped aboard the Sea of Dreams. Swarmed by nightmarish foes at every turn, you must fight, adapt, and grow stronger to stand a chance against the horrors that lurk in the shadows. Upgrade your abilities, unlock powerful perks, and carve your own path through the chaos.

This standalone experience delivers pure, heart-pounding action while staying true to the unsettling atmosphere of Sea of Dreams. Will you endure the horrors of The Other World and escape, or will you become another lost soul, swallowed by the nightmare?

A huge thank you to all Sea of Dreams players for your incredible support. This journey wouldn’t be possible without you! We can’t wait for you to dive into this new adventure.

The nightmare begins… Will you survive?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484590/Sea_of_Dreams_Survivors/

💀 Wishlist Sea of Dreams Survivors now on Steam! 💀

notes.title: Exciting News for Sea of Dreams Players: No-DRM Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
Ahoy, survivors! We’re thrilled to announce that Sea of Dreams is now available in a No-DRM version, updated with all the latest features, content, and improvements from the current Steam release.

We understand how important accessibility and ownership are to our players, and this release is our way of giving you the freedom to enjoy Sea of Dreams on your own terms, without any restrictions.

[h1]What’s Included?[/h1]
[b]🛠 Latest Update[/b]: Packed with all the recent fixes, performance enhancements, and new features introduced in the Steam version.
[b]🎮 Full Game Experience[/b]: The complete Sea of Dreams adventure, free of any digital rights management.

This is our heartfelt thank-you to our incredible community for your continued support and passion for the world of Sea of Dreams. Dive into the adventure today and make it truly yours.

[b]Where to Get It?[/b]
The No-DRM version of Sea of Dreams (Windows & Linux) is now available on Steam. Right click on the game inside your library, [b]Properties > Betas > Beta participation and select no-drm[/b]. Be warned, achievements doesn't work with this version because the Steam DRM is not setup (but cloud save works). Then, also in the right click menu, [b]Manage > Browse local files[/b] and from here you can copy the files to get your DRM-free version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603616/7e2ad6cbfa8ba55724678483b454349cf5d11dc6.png[/img]

Download it today and set sail for the ultimate gaming freedom!

Thank you for being part of our journey, and as always, may your dreams guide you across the endless horizon. 🌊✨

notes.title: Sea of Dreams update, Quality of Life and more 👻
notes.notes:
An update has been released for Sea of Dreams. A little late for Halloween sadly.

[h2]General changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Upgrade of the engine to the latest Unity version (Unity 6).
[*] DirectX 12 support.
[*] The game starts faster, there is no splash screen anymore.
[*] We have updated our privacy policy regarding telemetry. You can read it there https://seaofdreams.dezeiraudgames.com/privacy-policy.
[*] Auto-save after important moments.
[*] A new language is available, Spanish!
[*] A new language is available, Portuguese!
[/list]

[h2]User Interface[/h2]

[list]
[*] Our rendering process has been reworked to make texts more crisp and readable at all resolutions.
[*] The interface now supports PlayStation controllers, with associated icons.
[*] A new interface is now available « Documents » allowing you to read from anywhere the text documents you have already opened.
[*] Reworked the dialogue system. You won't see the difference but it now allows for infinitely long texts. Useful for new translations!
[/list]

[h2]Story & narration[/h2]

[list]
[*] The 'Other World' is no longer purple but light blue. Like ice.
[*] Added sound in elevator when access card is required.
[*] Rewrite message when using CD in computer.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes :[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed pool lights no longer being visible.
[*] Improved transition at resume, where the player can be seen in the "player room" during milliseconds before being teleported to the good room.
[*] Fixed "refresh rate" not being applied correctly from video settings.
[*] Fixed missing sound when reading a newspaper.
[/list]

notes.title: Thank you, and a small request!
notes.notes:
Hi friends. I've received so many nice comments about this game over the years, and I just wanted to say thank you. It's so personally rewarding for me to hear stories of friends and families bonding together and having fun, and I'm so honored and thankful that I could be a small part of that.

If you haven't already, would you please consider taking a minute and writing a brief review of the game?

I would never ask you to lie or give a fake review. But if the game has brought you some joy and you'd recommend it to others, taking just a minute or two to write what you liked and didn't like would really help me out.

notes.notes:
[b]This is no longer necessary, the game now uses the no-DRM version by default. The game no longer supports Steam achievements as a result of the change (but we didn't find them consistent anyway).[/b]



[h3]Hello everyone, it's time for an announcement![/h3]

Big announcement. Not for everyone, but some will be happy! A DRM-free version is now available of Sea of Dreams on Steam. Please note that this version is only available for Windows and does not contain the Steam API. It is therefore not possible to obtain achievements in this one.

Right click on Paug > Properties > Betas > Beta Participation and choose "no-drm - Sea of Dreams without DRM".

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603616/7e2ad6cbfa8ba55724678483b454349cf5d11dc6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603616/2526a80012a0f21f016706f2bda80594e05806fa.png[/img][/url]

So you can copy the game files wherever you want, a USB key, a NAS or even a floppy disk why not. Please be honest and do not share the DRM-free version on the internet for piracy.

Note again, that this version is for Windows Only, without Steam achievement, without Steam DRM.
So, thank you again to all of my player! Hope you enjoy Sea of Dreams ːsteamhappyː.

notes.title: Sea of Dreams Update - September 2022
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,
Today we are releasing a small update for Sea of Dreams. We are working on quality-of-life updates, and bug fixes.

Here the list:
[list]
[*] Changed the term CD to disc.
[*] Removed Lucie's dialog from the chest code, which is confusing (because it's already open). It simply indicates to manage.
[*] Monologue in the vault chamber, where the player remarks to himself that he was forced into it.
[*] Closing the casino door behind the player on the player's first visit. He must solve the riddle of the casino to be able to leave (this lets the player know that he has something to do in the room, and that he is not walking around without understanding where to go).
[*] Fixed a music bug, if the sound was at 0 and the player started a new game, there was still game music.
[*] Fixed lights in control room, shader issue with some graphics cards.
[*] Unity update.
[*] Changed the "where_are_all" dialog with indication of rooms and casino.
[*]  Changed main menu design.
[*] Updated game engine. This results in improved performance and end of x32-bit support.
[*] We have reworked the light system. And the visual ambiance of the game.
[*] Changed keyboard keys are retained after starting the game.
[*] We have reworked the preference system (game settings).
[*] We've reworked Steam achievement icons.
[*] We readjusted the sound of the newspaper.
[*] A small luminous glow is present around the player during the running pursuit.
[/list]

We also introduced the [i]Sea of Dreams launcher[/i]. A small tool that allows you to modify the settings of the game before being in it. It also helps you access support if needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603616/51025e523425b1ba9b6171078103b0f14ca72f31.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41603616/903ebbf6ba8bc279e079c1f9db124966ccf0e88b.png[/img]

Thank you again for your feedback.

notes.title: Sea of Dreams release date, 05/05/2022
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

I'm here to answer that everyone is asking "When is Sea of Dreams going to come out?".
And I am pleased to tell you that a date has been found. It will be the 05/05/2022.

We know it's hard to wait! To apologize for the game's previous postponement, the full Sea of Dreams OST is available now and for free on YouTube. Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=gAvo5tOO6JA;full][/previewyoutube]

Above, some answers to questions you have asked us.

[i]On what system I can play Sea of Dreams?[/i]
The game is natively compatible with Windows and macOS. For linux, we do not offer a native version, however the game is 100% playable via Proton.

[i]How long to finish the game?[/i]
Difficult to answer precisely. it will depend on the time you take to solve the puzzles! Count about 2 hours.

[i]Can I play with a gamepad?[/i]
Yes.

[i]Do you support the Steam Deck?[/i]
We don't have the device to try it ourselves. However, we have thoroughly tested compatibility with Proton. If you have the Steam Deck, please share your experience with Sea of Dreams when the game is released!

notes.title: Postponement of the game's release date
notes.notes:
Dear players. Today I want to share an important Sea of Dreams development update with the community. I have made the difficult decision to shift the release to late 2022 to ensure we have the adequate time to deliver a game experience that meets your vision. 

Thank you for your support and understanding.
